title: OpenClaw 2026.5.20: Discord Voice Follow, Policy Checks, and Safer Agent Operations
summary: OpenClaw 2026.5.20 ships Discord Voice Follow (your agent joins voice calls with you), a bundled Policy plugin, safer cron runs, Codex 0.132.0, and a dozen key fixes.
body_markdown: Voice Follow is available immediately after upgrading to v2026.5.20. Configure your allowed voice channels in the Discord integration settings — the agent will only follow you into channels you've explicitly pre-authorized. Multi-user handoff and DAVE recovery work automatically once Voice Follow is active.
